Field Descriptions

OUTPUT_COUNT

Number of 32-bit digest words remaining to be output (0-7). When hashing completes, 8 words are available for output. This counter decrements as words are consumed by downstream FIFO. 0 indicates all digest words have been output.

INPUT_COUNT

Number of 32-bit words accumulated in SHA-256 input buffer (0-15). When this reaches 15 and the next word arrives, hashing begins. Useful for monitoring whitener activity and throughput.

BUSY

SHA-256 is actively hashing. Set when accumulating input buffer is complete and hash computation is in progress. Cleared when digest output phase completes.
